# Brad Bartlett — AI Marketing & Content Strategy

> Brad Bartlett is an independent AI marketing and content strategist based in Kansas City, Missouri. He helps expert-led businesses understand how AI affects buyer discovery, improve their brand messaging, and put content strategy into practice. Clients work directly with Brad.

Brad runs a solo consultancy. He leads the strategy and client relationship, with hands-on writing and editing available within an agreed project scope.

His clients include founders of expert-led service businesses, B2B and SaaS marketing teams, and agencies seeking senior strategic or content support.

His work covers AI-search visibility, also called generative engine optimization (GEO), alongside brand positioning and content development. Engagements connect strategic advice with practical work on the message and content buyers encounter.

AI-search projects assess an agreed set of buyer questions and document a visibility baseline. Citations and rankings are not guaranteed. The client results on this site describe specific samples, not expected outcomes for every business.

Website: https://www.bradleebartlett.com/
Contact: brad@bradleebartlett.com
Last updated: 2026-11-06

## Services

- [AI Search Clarity Session](https://www.bradleebartlett.com/services#clarity): A focused strategy conversation for businesses that need direction before investing in a larger AI-search project. Includes a recommended next step and the reasoning behind it.
- [AI Visibility & Authority Audit](https://www.bradleebartlett.com/services#audit): An assessment against agreed buyer questions, with a documented visibility baseline and prioritized action plan. Current scope and pricing are on this page.
- [Ongoing AI Marketing Advisory](https://www.bradleebartlett.com/services#advisory): Continued strategic support for marketing decisions, including reviewing content and deciding where AI belongs in the team's process.
- [Implementation & Content Support](https://www.bradleebartlett.com/services#implementation): Hands-on work on positioning, website copy, or an expert content library. Can include writing, editing, and an editorial process for AI-assisted drafts.
